description: Close the toaster oven door. | Continue the original whole-task code assignment with a bounded diagnostic stage. Revision 5 produced an empty closure and no rim lift. This revision only opens the fingers at the current measured raised pose, records actual state and calibration metadata, and returns fresh views for measuring the true separation axis. It is limited to 16 steps and retains code ownership; it does not claim a grasp or release the unfinished subtask to VLA.

stages.name: open fingers at the current raised pose to measure their actual axis
